data.itinerary:
Get ready to explore paradise one sweet bite at a time on the Underground Donut Tour Key West. This laid-back, flavor-packed walking tour starts at Glazed Donuts, where we kick things off with freshly made donuts before heading out to wander the streets of Old Town Key West. From there, the tour becomes a delicious adventure through the island, mixing tropical vibes, local history, and plenty of sweet stops along the way.​

As we stroll through Old Town, you’ll sample a variety of beloved Key West treats based on what the group is most excited to try. That could mean classic Key lime pie, cookies, ice cream, local donuts, or even “Key West donuts,” better known as conch fritters. Every tour is a little different, making each experience unique and tailored to the group’s tastes. Along the way, your guide will share fun stories, quirky local lore, and insights into what makes Key West such a one-of-a-kind destination. 

With beautiful scenery, plenty of photo opportunities, and a rotating lineup of incredible sweet treats, this tour is perfect for couples, friends, families, or anyone who wants to experience Key West in a fun, relaxed, and delicious way.

data.cancellation_notes:
**For Customers That Book Directly on Our Website:**
We are happy to provide you with a full refund if you contact us 24 hours prior to your booking. If contacted less than 24 hours prior to your scheduled tour, we cannot provide a refund, however, we can rebook you for a future date or a different city (we’re in a lot of different cities). The reason for this is that as part of your scheduled tour we assign your tour guide and arrange orders with our partners ahead of time (donuts, drinks, etc.), so last minute cancellations may cause us to incur food and drink costs so as to maintain our relationship with our partners. We also pay our guides, even in the event of a tour cancellation, since they have arranged their schedule around our tour schedule. So if at all possible, please give us 24 hours notice if you cannot attend your tour. 

**For Customers Who Book Through a 3rd Party (Airbnb, TripAdvisor, etc.):**
The customer will need to reach out to that 3rd party directly. Depending on their cancellation policy, they may be able to provide you a refund. If they request that we approve the refund, we will. The refund will come directly from that 3rd party and we are not responsible for how long the refund may take to appear on your statement as we are not in control of their financial policies.

**For any questions:**
Visit our [contact us page](https://www.undergrounddonuttour.com/contact-us) to get in touch with our team.

## Booked the tour - Now get the Merch!
The Underground Donut Tour has a ton of great merchandise for sale as well. Tshirts, hoodies, hats, stickers and more. 
**[Visit our store today!](https://www.undergrounddonuttour.com/store?utm_source=fareharbor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=confirmationemail)**

[![Donut Merchandise](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e389b4_d6f9f6aed4f04538872b8c131da7d3c0~mv2.jpg)](https://www.undergrounddonuttour.com/store?utm_source=fareharbor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=confirmationemail)

_________

**Timely Departures**
Many of our tours have a tendency to sell out and we have to respect the schedules of our other guests, so we have to begin our tours on time. We will wait until 10 minutes after the hour and then we'll have to begin the tour. If you are going to arrive more than 10 minutes after the start of the tour, please call 844-366-8848 to meet us at our second location.

**Tour Start and End**
Please note that all of our tours do not end where they start, so if you have questions regarding parking, public transportation, etc. please ask your guide or contact us prior to the tour for the best recommendations. All tours are roughly 1.5-2 miles long, so you should plan to wear comfortable shoes and clothing, dependent on the weather. Most tours can be walked end to end in about 30 minutes, so you can always walk back to the beginning, take a cab, public transit or find another means of returning to the starting point fairly easily.

__________

## What to Bring

Please make sure to bring your appetite. There will be plenty of donuts for everyone. This tour is outside, so please dress according to the weather. Also - if you have any food allergies, please let us know ahead of time, so we can prepare accordingly.

## Thanks so much for booking!

_______

Please know that the tour does not come back to the starting location, so please remember where you parked, if you decide to drive to the tour.

Please remember that if you need to cancel or reschedule the activity for any reason, you can call 844-366-8848 or email info@undergrounddonuttour.com. If you have any other questions, feel free to get in touch.
